$doc: §23.6 ST-3. The C-8 band row (the stochastic loss rate vs the physical Monte Carlo) waits for CE-8009; what is checkable without it is encoded: losses on both sides, suppression, and who breaks first. Slot health is 25 when whole (UnitSplits.SlotFullHealth); 'down' = Health < 0.5 (UnitSlotTable.DownBelow); 'broken' = Stress >= 0.75 (AggregateUnits.BrokenAt). A Red squad is 10 slots; measured: by 3.25 s eight of its slots are down and four have broken, while the platoon loses one or two slots and never breaks.

expect.name: the fight reaches the Blue platoon (a slot is down)
the fight reaches the Red squad (most of it is down)
the weaker side (Red) breaks: four slots at the break level
the stronger side (Blue) has not broken when Red has
